content.comment_body: Hello, Is there a way to track elapsed time for an action (input or output) in hours, minutes, and seconds, and show this information on the [product_name] display? Thank you, [user_name]
Yes, it's possible by using an asynchronous pulse generator and multiple counters. The accuracy may vary. Please refer to the example provided in the attachment. Regards,
Hello [user_name], Thank you for sharing the example. I can apply this to my requirements. The biggest limitation is how little information the [product_name] display can show at once!
You can implement a menu structure to present additional details on your display. An example is available at: [url] Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are addressing how to monitor and show elapsed time for an action in hours, minutes, and seconds on a [product_name] text display. A method involving pulse generators and counters is suggested, but there are concerns about limited accuracy and the restricted screen space of the display. The potential use of menu structures is highlighted to mitigate display limitations and improve usability.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks to display elapsed time (hours, minutes, seconds) for specific actions in a clear format on the [product_name] display, and hopes the display can show all necessary details without space restrictions.
